mapper.select: SELECT d.sku_id, k.code AS sku_code, COALESCE(k.title, s.title) AS sku_name, k.code AS bar_code, d.batch_number, d.target_warehouse_area_loca_id AS warehouse_area_loca_id, l.loca_code, SUM(d.allocated_count) AS total_pick_count FROM wms_outbound_order o JOIN wms_outbound_order_details d ON d.outbound_order_id = o.id AND d.is_del = 1 LEFT JOIN wms_item_sku k ON k.id = d.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_item_spu s ON s.id = k.spu_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse_area_loca l ON l.id = d.target_warehouse_area_loca_id WHERE o.wave_id = #{waveId} AND o.is_del = 1 GROUP BY d.sku_id, k.code, COALESCE(k.title, s.title), k.code, d.batch_number, d.target_warehouse_area_loca_id, l.loca_code ORDER BY l.loca_code ASC, d.sku_id ASC
SELECT * FROM wms_wave_order WHERE wave_code = #{waveCode} AND is_del = 1 LIMIT 1
